The team was originally owned by John J. Kuczek.
Marion Mayhem | The Marion Mayhem were a professional indoor football team based in Marion, Ohio.  The team was a charter member of the Great Lakes Indoor Football League (GLIFL), later renamed the Continental Indoor Football League (CIFL), joining in 2006 as an expansion team.  The Mayhem were the first professional indoor football team to be based in Marion, but were the second pro football team to be based in the area since the NFL's Oorang Indians.
